title: Inspector Panel — Unity3D-Style Property Inspector with Field Renderers
description: Create the Inspector Panel with Unity3D-style variable renderers for shader component uniforms. Implement field components for each type: FloatField (slider + input), Vec2Field, Vec3Field, Vec4Field (multi-input), ColorField (color picker), BoolField (checkbox), EnumField (select). Add a ShaderComponentHeader with component name and 'Edit' button that triggers prompt re-editing. Inspector shows fields for the selected layer's shader components.
acceptance_criteria: Inspector renders shader component uniforms for selected layer
FloatField: slider + numeric input with min/max/step
Vec2Field: two labeled float inputs (x, y)
Vec3Field: three labeled float inputs (x, y, z)
Vec4Field: four labeled float inputs (x, y, z, w)
ColorField: color picker integration from ui-library
EnumField: select dropdown with defined options
ShaderComponentHeader shows component name and 'Edit' button
Edit button triggers prompt re-editing mode (sets UIStore state)
All field changes update MobX store reactively
completion_summary: Inspector panel with 7 field renderers (Float, Vec2, Vec3, Vec4, Color, Bool, Enum), UniformField dispatcher, ShaderComponentHeader with edit/remove/enable toggle, layer info panel. All using existing ui-library components. Typecheck passes.
